build.buildCommand: export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-file:/app/db/custom.db}" && if ls public/games/sonic-escape/index.pck.part-* >/dev/null 2>&1; then cat public/games/sonic-escape/index.pck.part-* > public/games/sonic-escape/index.pck; fi && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && npx next build

deploy.startCommand: export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-file:/app/db/custom.db}" && npx prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && npm start
